text: There's a little black bird in the Kalahari Desert... that never hunts.
and other animals drop their lunch!
They spend all day with their noses in the sand, digging for beetles, scorpions, and the occasional, very unlucky lizard.
But a meerkat with its head in a hole can't see the sky.
And the sky is full of hawks!
So one meerkat always stands guard,
and the second it spots trouble, it barks a warning,
Then one morning, a new guy shows up.
A small black bird with a forked tail, called a drongo.
